name: muse-ai
title: Muse AI
description: Muse AI (Meta Model API) within Raycast — use Muse Spark in AI Chat, Quick AI and AI Commands
author: alhassanaraouf

commands.name: ask-muse-ai
commands.title: Ask Muse AI
commands.subtitle: Meta Model API
commands.description: Ask questions using Muse Spark via Meta Model API, with conversation history

preferences.title: Model API Key
preferences.name: MODEL_API_KEY
preferences.description: Meta Model API key from https://dev.meta.ai (looks like LLM|...). Stored only in Raycast preferences.

preferences.title: Muse Model
preferences.name: MUSE_MODEL
preferences.description: Default model for Ask Muse AI. The command lets you pick any available Muse Spark model; this is preselected, e.g. muse-spark-1.3

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
